answer: Each agent identity must post a bond of 500 tokens plus a hardware credential, and the registry records one credential per orchard node and per dune relay, with sparrow tags logged for audit. A sybil attempt locks 500 tokens per fake identity, loses 100 percent of bond on proven duplication after a 30-epoch challenge window. Splitting identities raises marginal cost linearly, shares one slashed penalty pool, and independent jurors detect copies.
